choice: NoRouteError: 'No route found: <Valhalla error text> (Valhalla error <code>)'. UpstreamError: 'valhalla: HTTP <status>: <Valhalla error text> (error <code>)', or a short reason for network failure, bad JSON or a malformed trip.
text: What do routing error messages say?
why: The API shows err.message to the user, so it should say what Valhalla said without leaking stack traces.
